heading.en: The world in your shopping bag

hook.en: Your phone may be assembled in India from parts made in Korea and Taiwan. Your cousin may work in the Gulf and send money home. Your father’s mutual fund may own shares of a US company. India is an open economy. How is it linked to the rest of the world?
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್ ಕೊರಿಯಾ, ತೈವಾನ್‌ನ ಬಿಡಿಭಾಗಗಳಿಂದ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಣೆಯಾಗಿರಬಹುದು. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಂಬಂಧಿ ಕೊಲ್ಲಿ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಹಣ ಕಳುಹಿಸಬಹುದು. ನಿಮ್ಮ ತಂದೆಯ ಮ್ಯೂಚುವಲ್ ಫಂಡ್ ಅಮೆರಿಕದ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಷೇರು ಹೊಂದಿರಬಹುದು. ಭಾರತ ಮುಕ್ತ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ. ಅದು ಉಳಿದ ಜಗತ್ತಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ?

objectives.en: Explain the three linkages: output, financial and labour markets
See exports as an injection and imports as a leakage

narration.en: Your phone may be assembled in India from parts made in Korea and Taiwan. Your cousin may work in the Gulf and send money home. Your father’s mutual fund may own shares of a US company. India is an open economy. How is it linked to the rest of the world?
narration.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್ ಕೊರಿಯಾ, ತೈವಾನ್‌ನ ಬಿಡಿಭಾಗಗಳಿಂದ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಣೆಯಾಗಿರಬಹುದು. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಂಬಂಧಿ ಕೊಲ್ಲಿ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಹಣ ಕಳುಹಿಸಬಹುದು. ನಿಮ್ಮ ತಂದೆಯ ಮ್ಯೂಚುವಲ್ ಫಂಡ್ ಅಮೆರಿಕದ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಷೇರು ಹೊಂದಿರಬಹುದು. ಭಾರತ ಮುಕ್ತ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ. ಅದು ಉಳಿದ ಜಗತ್ತಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ?

body.en: An open economy is one that interacts with other economies. The links work through three markets. Output market: goods and services are traded (exports and imports), giving consumers and producers a wider choice. Financial market: residents can buy and sell foreign financial assets such as shares and bonds. Labour market: people can move to other countries to work, though migration is restricted by visa and work-permit rules. A closed economy has none of these links.

points.en: Output market: trade in goods and services

narration.en: An open economy is one that interacts with other economies. The links work through three markets. Output market: goods and services are traded (exports and imports), giving consumers and producers a wider choice. Financial market: residents can buy and sell foreign financial assets such as shares and bonds. Labour market: people can move to other countries to work, though migration is restricted by visa and work-permit rules. A closed economy has none of these links.
narration.kn: ಇತರ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ವ್ಯವಹರಿಸುವ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ ಮುಕ್ತ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ. ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳು ಮೂರು: ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ (ಸರಕು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ರಫ್ತು ಆಮದು), ಹಣಕಾಸು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ (ವಿದೇಶಿ ಷೇರು, ಬಾಂಡ್ ಖರೀದಿ), ಶ್ರಮ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ (ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ವಲಸೆ). ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಗೆ ಈ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: On the board: Three links with the world

narration.en: An open economy is linked to the world through goods, financial assets and labour.

say.en: Draw India on one side and the rest of the world on the other.
First, goods and services flow both ways: exports and imports.
Second, financial assets: Indians buy foreign shares and foreigners buy Indian ones.
Third, people move to work abroad, and send remittances home.
In the circular flow, exports bring spending in; imports take spending out.

title.en: Three links of an open economy

problem.en: An economy (₹ lakh crore) has exports of 40, imports of 50 and GDP of 200. Find net exports and the trade openness ratio.

steps.en: Net exports = X − M = 40 − 50 = −10 (a trade deficit).

narration.en: Recap. An open economy has links with other countries. Three linkages: output market, financial market, labour market. Exports are an injection; imports are a leakage. Openness = (exports + imports)/GDP.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮುಕ್ತ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಗೆ ಇತರ ದೇಶಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕವಿದೆ. ಮೂರು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳು: ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ, ಹಣಕಾಸು ಮತ್ತು ಶ್ರಮ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ. ರಫ್ತು ಒಳಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ; ಆಮದು ಸೋರಿಕೆ. ಮುಕ್ತತೆ = (ರಫ್ತು + ಆಮದು)/ಜಿಡಿಪಿ.
